articles.summary: Rising power densities in embedded computing continue to challenge traditional thermal management. Modern processors, FPGAs, and high‑performance modules routinely exceed the cooling capabilities of forced‑air systems, especially in compact 3U Eurocard environments. To meet these demands, the Easy Swap LFT (Liquid Flow Through) platform introduces a new approach to liquid cooling that integrates seamlessly into existing 19” card‑cage infrastructures.
articles.title: Easy Swap LFT: Advancing Liquid Cooling Technology for High Density 3U Eurocard Systems
